name: Pokémon Black Pearl Emerald
summary: Pokémon Black Pearl Emerald is an enhancement ROM hack, with the aim of modernizing the Emerald experience with new quality of life features, advanced custom trainer AI, multiple difficulty options, and, of course, all Pokemon from Gen 1-9, obtainable via wild encounters.
